scenes.text: Brief, intense pulses of radio energy
Located at the Parkes Radio Telescope in Australia
Fast Radio Bursts (FRBs) are brief, intense pulses of radio energy that have been detected coming from distant galaxies
The Parkes Radio Telescope in Australia, where the first FRB was detected
